seller_or_subject: Steville Hattingh — South Africa: positive review, fees "neither high nor low"
what: Creator praises Patreon's consistency, trustworthiness, and ease of use. States "The cut Patreon takes is neither high nor low but of course this makes sense." Notes integration limitations as the only drawback.
verbatim_snippet: "Patreon offers consistency, trustworthiness and the team behind Patreon really tries their best to bring out features that is easy to understand and use. There may be some features I add but in general that means such must apply to the all creators and that is simply not possible speaking as a developer myself. What Patreon does, it does well. It is really not complex to use. Of course, there will always be alternatives but for me it really offers what I need. The cut Patreon takes is neither high nor low but of course this makes sense."
notes: 4-star rating — only positive creator review identified in the window. Creator confirmed ("speaking as a developer myself," "if you are a content creator").
